reasons.plausibility: Leveraging microstructural descriptors within an ML framework to improve mechanical property predictions is grounded in known structure–property relationships, though the claimed magnitude of performance gains (20% error reduction and 50% time reduction) may be somewhat optimistic.
reasons.testability: A direct comparison of the new ML-based approach to conventional simulations under the same testing conditions, with clear quantitative metrics for improvement, provides a decisive means of falsifying the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: If valid, this method would enable faster and more accurate property predictions, strongly benefiting high-entropy alloy research and design.
